context: Universal Editor setup in aem-boilerplate-xwalk. Criteria come from aem.live (component-model-definitions, universal-editor-blocks) and the repo's AGENTS.md, not from the skills.

checklist.name: Partial file, root files regenerated
checklist.description: Component definition, model and filters are written in `blocks/<name>/_<name>.json` (and `models/_section.json` for the section filter), and the root component-definition.json, component-models.json and component-filters.json are regenerated with `npm run build:json` rather than hand-edited alone. Score 0 if only the root files were edited and no partial exists.

checklist.name: Definitions valid
checklist.description: Each definition uses the right resource type: `core/franklin/components/section/v1/section` for a section type such as a tab panel, `core/franklin/components/block/v1/block` for any authored block, with a template name where the type needs one; template `model` or `filter` values match model or filter ids that exist.

checklist.name: Registered where authors can add it
checklist.description: The custom tab section type is registered in the `main` filter (models/_component-filters.json partial) so authors can add tab sections at page level; the tab section's filter allows default content and the `cards` block; any newly authored block is in the `section` filter (models/_section.json).

checklist.name: Valid and consistent JSON
checklist.description: All JSON files parse, ids are unique, and no existing entries were removed or broken.

checklist.name: Scope kept
checklist.description: decorate JS and CSS of unrelated blocks are untouched; no custom AEM component or resource type is invented.

checklist.name: Tabs are sections, not nested blocks
checklist.description: Tabs are modelled as sections: a section-type definition (resourceType `core/franklin/components/section/v1/section`, e.g. id `tab`) that code can auto-block into tabs. A `tabs` block whose cells or container items hold `cards` blocks scores 0.

checklist.name: Tab label is authorable
checklist.description: Authors can set each tab's label: either a `tab-label`/`title`-style field on the tab section's model (rendered as section metadata, the maintainers' example pattern) or a heading in default content that the tabs code reads. Either earns full credit; a label hard-coded in code or placed only in the block name scores low.

checklist.name: Tab sections can hold intro and cards
checklist.description: The tab section can contain default content and the `cards` block (its filter lists `text`, `cards` or equivalent), and the existing cards block definition is unchanged.
